title: The Copper Canyon
author: Barış Kısır
premise: The copper strike at Cañon del Cobre has brought a hundred men, three saloons, and one lawman to a canyon that had only ever known sheep. Deputy sheriff Rosa Aguilar, raised on the canyon\'s sheep trails, must keep the peace among the miners — and find out who is stealing the copper that has made the canyon rich enough to kill for.
